verdict.rationale: WooCommerce documents a versioned public REST API under /wp-json/wc/v3/ with full CRUD over store data via JSON and HTTP verbs, read/write-scoped API keys tied to WordPress roles, and official JS/PHP/Python/Ruby libraries. It adds a public Store API for cart and checkout, webhooks for events, and an llms.txt docs index, so an AI-native user can drive the store programmatically. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI spec was found (all probed paths returned 404), no published deprecation-timeline policy, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of API usage.
